title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
description: Explore the essential streets and corridors surrounding Biola University, featuring the most practical off-campus destinations for students in La Mirada.

cards.entity_name: La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts
cards.title: La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: La Mirada Boulevard
cards.notes: Visit this city-owned venue for Broadway-caliber musicals and concerts located just a short drive south of the university campus.
cards.short_summary: A premier performing arts venue on La Mirada Boulevard hosting professional theatrical productions and live entertainment.
cards.evidence_claim: La Mirada Theatre for the Performing Arts is located at 14900 La Mirada Blvd and offers Broadway-caliber entertainment.
cards.access_notes: The box office is open Monday through Friday from 11 a.m. to 5 p.m. and Saturday from 12 p.m. to 4 p.m.

cards.title: Civitas Coffee
cards.subtitle: Rosecrans Avenue
cards.notes: Head to this local coffee house on Rosecrans Avenue for a community-focused atmosphere and specialty espresso drinks.
cards.short_summary: A popular local coffee shop on Rosecrans Avenue known for its community atmosphere and quality brews.
cards.evidence_claim: Civitas Coffee is located at 14218 Rosecrans Ave, La Mirada, CA 90638.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 7 a.m. to 5 p.m. (8 a.m. on Sundays).

cards.title: The Cyclery Bike Shop
cards.subtitle: Imperial Highway
cards.notes: Get your bicycle serviced or browse new gear at this full-service shop located on the Imperial Highway corridor.
cards.short_summary: A full-service local bike shop on Imperial Highway providing repairs, parts, and accessories for cyclists.
cards.evidence_claim: The Cyclery Bike Shop is a local full-service bike shop located at 15037 Imperial Highway, La Mirada.
cards.source_title: Shopping Archives - Discover La Mirada California

cards.entity_name: Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center
cards.title: Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center
cards.subtitle: La Mirada Boulevard
cards.notes: Enjoy lap swimming or the Buccaneer Bay water park at this major recreational facility on La Mirada Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A comprehensive aquatics center on La Mirada Boulevard featuring competition pools and a pirate-themed water park.
cards.evidence_claim: Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center is located at 13806 La Mirada Blvd and includes Buccaneer Bay waterpark.
cards.source_title: Splash! La Mirada Regional Aquatics Center
cards.access_notes: Offers lap swim, recreational swim, and water exercise classes; hours vary by season.

cards.title: Green Hills Plaza
cards.subtitle: Imperial Highway
cards.notes: Shop for affordable dorm decor and school supplies at Five Below and other retailers in this plaza on Imperial Highway.
cards.short_summary: A shopping center on Imperial Highway featuring budget-friendly retail options like Five Below and Dollar Tree.
cards.evidence_claim: Five Below is located in Green Hills Plaza at 15743 Imperial Hwy, La Mirada, CA 90638.
cards.access_notes: Open until 9:30 p.m. most nights for late-evening shopping.

cards.title: Albertsons Shopping Center
cards.subtitle: Rosecrans Avenue
cards.notes: Pick up groceries or custom cakes at this major supermarket located at the intersection of Rosecrans and La Mirada Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A central grocery and retail hub on Rosecrans Avenue serving the Biola student community.
cards.evidence_claim: Albertsons is located at 15200 Rosecrans Ave, La Mirada, CA 90638.
cards.source_title: Bakery Near Me in La Mirada, CA - Albertsons
cards.access_notes: Features a full-service bakery and online ordering for carryout.

cards.title: Chop'd - La Mirada
cards.subtitle: La Mirada Boulevard
cards.notes: Grab a fresh salad, wrap, or acai bowl at this casual dining spot located on the La Mirada Boulevard corridor.
cards.short_summary: A casual eatery on La Mirada Boulevard offering healthy food options like salads and wraps.
cards.evidence_claim: Chop'd - La Mirada is located at 12754 La Mirada Boulevard, La Mirada, CA 90638.
cards.access_notes: Offers vegetarian options and free parking.

cards.title: Cream and Sugar
cards.subtitle: Biola Avenue
cards.notes: Walk just outside the campus gates on Biola Avenue to this coffee shop, a favorite for students without cars.
cards.short_summary: A student-favorite coffee shop located immediately adjacent to the Biola University campus on Biola Avenue.
cards.evidence_claim: Cream and Sugar is a coffee shop right outside of campus within walking distance from Biola.
cards.access_notes: Easily accessible by foot from the Biola University main entrance.

cards.title: La Mirada Golf Course
cards.subtitle: Alicante Road
cards.notes: Practice your swing at this 18-hole public course located on Alicante Road, just east of the university.
cards.short_summary: A public 18-hole golf course and pro shop located near the university campus.
cards.evidence_claim: La Mirada Golf Course is an 18-hole public golf course located at 15501 Alicante Road, La Mirada.
cards.source_title: Shopping Archives - Discover La Mirada California
cards.access_notes: Public course with a pro shop on site.

cards.title: La Mirada Regional Park
cards.subtitle: La Mirada Boulevard
cards.notes: Take a break from studies at this large park featuring disc golf, tennis courts, and walking paths along La Mirada Boulevard.
cards.short_summary: A expansive regional park offering various outdoor recreational activities adjacent to the campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: La Mirada Regional Park is a nearby park located in La Mirada, accessible from the campus area.
cards.source_title: Imperial Hwy & Biola Ave, La Mirada CA - Walk Score
cards.access_notes: Public park access is free; certain facilities may have specific hours.
